As major customers, Sumisho Metalex Corporation and Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. are stated in the filing as customers related to both the titanium business and the high-performance materials business.

entries.2f37d9195036e55e: Net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,576 million, a decrease of 63.7% from the same period of the previous year. The filing describes the impact of a significant decrease in domestic sales volume and of lower selling prices for exports caused by price formulas.
entries.32bb32c2e5db4eee: In the titanium business, the company manufactures and sells metallic titanium (sponge titanium and titanium ingots); in the high-performance materials business, it manufactures and sells high-purity titanium, SiO, TILOP® (spherical titanium powder), powdered titanium, titanium tetrachloride and titanium tetrachloride aqueous solution. Production is carried out at its head office and Amagasaki Plant and at the Kishiwada Works.

entries.41a74ffc333112a5: There are two reportable segments, the titanium business and the high-performance materials business; external revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥40,444 million for the titanium business and ¥6,507 million for the high-performance materials business. Revenue by region was ¥11,133 million for Japan, ¥29,303 million for the United States, ¥512 million for China and ¥6,002 million for other regions, with sales to the United States the largest. Major customers are Sumisho Metalex Corporation and Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd., and both are stated to be related to the titanium business and the high-performance materials business.

entries.cdcd605608392050: The company manufactures and sells titanium tetrachloride, aqueous titanium tetrachloride solution and SiO. From the current fiscal year, titanium tetrachloride and aqueous titanium tetrachloride solution are classified as main products of the High-Performance Materials Business rather than the Titanium Business. Research and development aimed at commercialization is under way for SiO as a negative electrode material for lithium secondary batteries.
entries.d04c884041ef07b5: It has formulated the medium-term management plan 'OTC2030', setting six policies for the plan period from fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030. Under the titanium business, it aims to strengthen production capacity by operating a new sponge titanium plant and build a supply system that meets growing aircraft demand; in terms of business portfolio, it aims to invest profits from the titanium business into the high-performance materials business to transform growth fields such as semiconductors and the environment; and, as GX promotion, it aims to create businesses in environmental fields, including entry into recycling.
entries.d5c0b5aecd04dfa9: Its predecessor began industrial production of metallic titanium in 1952, the first in Japan, and its former brand 'Osaka Titanium' is said to have a reputation worldwide for top-grade quality. In research and development, the filing states that the titanium business has industry-leading product quality and productivity, and research is under way to improve productivity and quality to maximize output.
